description: Compile-time lifecycle orchestration for Go. Google Wire builds the dependency graph. Yama generates code that starts, quiesces, and stops the graph in dependency order.
rules: Import the module as l7e.io/yama, not github.com/livetribe/yama.
Pin github.com/google/wire/cmd/wire and l7e.io/yama/cmd/yama in the tool block of go.mod.
Put the lifecycle stub behind //go:build yamainject. Put //go:generate go tool yama in a file that no build tag excludes.
Do not edit lifecycle_gen.go. Run go generate to make it again.
Use yama.RunUntilSignal to run the Lifecycle that the generated constructor returns.
